blocks.text: USDA Rural Development — Centralized Training Site Analysis
Real captured quotes: flights (ITA Matrix) & hotels (us.trip.com)
Training dates Nov 29 – Dec 1, 2026  |  Trip Nov 28 – Dec 2 (4 nights)  |  24 attendees
All quotes queried 2026-10-24 (UTC), in USD. Links to conference_budget.xlsx (Options/Sources).
Provenance & limitations — read before relying on figures

• Flights — ITA Matrix (matrix.itasoftware.com): round trip DCA↔destination, depart 2026-11-28, return 2026-12-02, 1 adult. Fares are total incl. taxes/carrier fees per ticket; cheapest may be Basic Economy.

• Hotels — us.trip.com: destination city list, check-in 2026-11-28 / check-out 2026-12-02 (4 nights), 1 room / 1 adult, currency USD. Nightly figure excludes taxes & fees; 'Total price' includes them.
• Screening standard applied to hotels: guest rating ≥ 8.0/10, ≥ 50 reviews, breakfast included or separately budgeted, and nightly rate at/below the FY2027 GSA lodging cap on every night.

• These are single-seat / single-room PUBLIC quotes captured on one date. They are NOT bookings, NOT held inventory, and NOT group rates. Group airfare inventory and a 24-room block at the quoted rate remain TO VERIFY (see approval_register.csv R-02, R-03).

• No price table in this deck is self-made: every figure shown is inside an actual platform screenshot. Derived event totals live in conference_budget.xlsx (Options sheet) and are reconciled there, not fabricated here.

• Other travel sites (Kayak, Booking.com, Marriott/IHG, Google Hotels) blocked automation or forced non-USD currency from this network, so ITA Matrix + trip.com were used as the consistent USD sources.

How these real quotes map into conference_budget.xlsx
• Each airfare above is entered once per city in the workbook's CityData sheet; the Options sheet multiplies by headcount (24/18) and applies the airfare factor (base ×1.0 and +20% stress).
• Each hotel nightly rate is multiplied by 4 nights and an internal 12% lodging-tax estimate (a planning placeholder — NOT the statutory Suffolk County rate; replace at booking, Register R-10).
• Registration $180/person (incl. 3 working lunches), agency-provided meals (Nov 28 dinner, Dec 1 dinner, Dec 2 lunch), light refreshments, and ground transport are added in Daily/Options.
• Recommended: Boston, 24 attendees — grand total $34,242.77 (base $32,612.16 + 5% reserve $1,630.61), ~$18,757 under the $53,000 ceiling.
• Decision rule: fit ceiling → maximize attendees → lowest total-with-reserve → alphabetical. Boston wins on breakfast-included $108 hotel + free shuttle despite higher airfare than Chicago.

• Still TO VERIFY before approval (not fabricated here): group air inventory, 24-room block at quoted rate, venue address/capacity/quote, FEMA fire-safe hotel status, funds availability, roster justification. See approval_register.csv.
